mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.name, r.region_level AS level, ST_XMin(r.boundary) AS west, ST_XMax(r.boundary) AS east, ST_YMin(r.boundary) AS south, ST_YMax(r.boundary) AS north, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(r.boundary, GREATEST(0.00005, GREATEST(ST_XMax(r.boundary) - ST_XMin(r.boundary), ST_YMax(r.boundary) - ST_YMin(r.boundary)) / 200)), 5) AS geometry_geo_json FROM project_regions pr JOIN regions r ON r.id = pr.region_id WHERE pr.project_id = #{projectId} AND r.boundary IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.region_level, r.name
